title: EEG foundation models vs compact decoders under test-time adaptation: code, frozen protocol, per-subject results and trained models of a pre-registered cross-subject motor-imagery benchmark
description:
Code, pre-registered protocol, job scripts, logs and all per-subject, per-seed results for a benchmark comparing a pretrained EEG foundation model (CBraMod with LoRA) and a compact aligned decoder (EEGNet + Euclidean alignment) under eight test-time adaptation methods (T3A, LAME, Tent and SHOT-IM at two pre-specified learning rates, Riemannian re-centring, and two rejected geometry-based methods, GeoRoute and RCTTA). Datasets: BCI Competition IV-2a (BNCI2014-001, 9 subjects) and Lee2019-MI (54 subjects), 5 seeds per cell, plus classical and deep source-model baselines.

Trained models: the four models-*.zip archives hold the seed-0 source models (PyTorch state_dicts with SHA-256 checksums) for every cross-validation fold: BCI IV-2a CBraMod-LoRA and EEGNet+EA (9 LOSO folds each) and Lee2019-MI CBraMod-LoRA and EEGNet+EA (6 folds each), trained with the frozen benchmark settings in the seed-0 convergence re-run. See MODELS.md in the code archive. The other four seeds can be re-trained from the included code, seeds and job scripts (GPU non-determinism may cause small differences).
